cause: not_confirmed; startup counter_exists=false and prior-runtime recovery are strongly ruled out. The adjacent measured-generation-1 then unknown-generation-2 receipts, 4ms apart, strongly indicate they were accepted in one node poll batch. A revoke of pending generation 2 or an apply failure before active journal commit fits the sequence; a later close of active generation 2 with a silent counter failure/over-budget result remains possible because the exact poll batch and command outcome were not recorded.
interpretation_limits: The API stores no node poll request ID, so the 4ms receipt gap strongly suggests a shared poll batch but does not independently prove it.
The measured prior generation and remaining lease time rule out its wall-clock expiry; they do not establish the generation-2 command outcome.
A revoke-before-activation, an apply failure while the journal is intent, and a later active-window counter failure can produce the same immutable unknown receipt sequence.
The missing command outcome, historical counter, and swallowed counter exception cannot be reconstructed from current state.
